_doc: Enemy tanks (brief 2.4; v4: docs/decisions/tank.md). Owner: rules. Schema: TankContentSchema.validate_enemies. Two frames, no conversion. Far kinds (light, medium, destroyer, heavy; the Behemoth) stand in the far panel: hold_m is the range from the hull's front in metres, entered from hold_m + enter_m at enter_mps (10 s), then held; move_mps for shifts and back-offs; weave_m, weave_s around the hold; linger_s until a light retires; shift_m on a timer (shift_every_s) or after each shot (shift_after_shot), never nearer than hold_m[0]; backoff_m after backoff_every_damage, up to retire_to_m; hit_half_m the half hit window in metres; telegraph_s before each shot (flank: the light's first shot). size_px and sprite stay on far kinds until the view has moved to TankEnemyKit. Near kinds (recon, tankette) burst from the bushes: spawn_px, burst_s, burst_px_s, then dash_px at dash_px_s with pause_s pauses (they fire while paused), and flee at flee_px or flee_after_s at flee_px_s; only the bow guns hit them. light_mult: the factor on light shells and bow rounds. HP is the same for every crew; counts scale by crew_count_scale, a solo hull takes crew_damage_scale of the damage and a solo Behemoth comes with bogies_by_crew's bogies. difficulty: multipliers on enemy HP, damage, accuracy, counts, telegraph length and the repair rate, and tank_loss; never an effort number (the schema refuses any other key). miss_m: how far from the hull a far shot that misses lands; miss_px: a near shot's miss. Telegraph + flight stays at least 6 s at Hard (test_tank_ballistics).
